description: This file defines the DefaultTbLogEntityActionService class, which implements logging and action handling for entity-related activities within the Thingsboard server. It provides methods to log actions and relations involving entities, with support for user context, exceptions, and additional info.

classes.name: DefaultTbLogEntityActionService
classes.description: Implementation of TbLogEntityActionService that handles logging of entity actions and relations.

methods.name: logEntityAction
methods.description: Logs an entity action with various overloads supporting different parameters such as user, exception, and additional info.

methods.name: logEntityRelationAction
methods.description: Logs actions related to entity relations, specifically the 'from' and 'to' entities involved.
